title: E-learning platform
goal: Describe learner and instructor services for course participation and assessment.

rubric.must: Learning Management System visibly surrounds the course and assessment use cases.
Enroll in Course, Access Learning Content, and Submit Assessment have dashed «include» arrows pointing to Authenticate.
Run Remote Proctoring extends Submit Assessment toward its proctoring required extension point.
Authenticate is associated with the external Identity Provider actor.
